sql.mssql: INSERT INTO BCO_CADBANCO (ID, NOMEBANCO, CODIGODOBANCO, SANDBOX) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ID), 0) + 1, 'Sicoob', 756, 'S' FROM BCO_CADBANCO WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BCO_CADBANCO WHERE CODIGODOBANCO = 756)
sql.oracle: INSERT INTO BCO_CADBANCO (ID, NOMEBANCO, CODIGODOBANCO, SANDBOX) SELECT NVL(MAX(ID), 0) + 1, 'Sicoob', 756, 'S' FROM BCO_CADBANCO WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BCO_CADBANCO WHERE CODIGODOBANCO = 756)
